$comment: Optional editor/type tooling. Pi loads the extension with its own loader (jiti) and Node 22.18+ runs the TypeScript tests directly, so there is no build step and no vendored compiler. `npm run typecheck` needs a `tsc` on PATH (or `npx -p typescript tsc -p tsconfig.json`) and checks the shipped extension against the Pi typings resolved from the global install below; adjust those paths if Pi is installed elsewhere. Tests and scripts are excluded: they exercise Pi's internals through dynamic imports, so they are run by Node rather than type-checked.
